info: A globe is a spherical model of Earth. It shows the seven continents, five oceans, the North and South Poles, and imaginary reference lines used to locate places. Latitude lines run east-west and measure distance north or south of the Equator, while longitude lines run north-south and measure distance east or west of the Prime Meridian. The Equator is at 0 degrees latitude, and the Prime Meridian is at 0 degrees longitude. The Tropics lie at about 23.5 degrees north and south, while the Polar Circles lie at about 66.5 degrees north and south. Earth rotates once in about 24 hours, producing day and night. Its axis is tilted by about 23.5 degrees, and this tilt, together with Earth's revolution around the Sun, causes the seasons.
